maria_cs: quick alert: a slice of recent activations (~last 48h trials) are seeing slow embedding/index times during the 02:00-03:30 UTC window. drafting a short customer note + credit offer. any blockers on wording?

sanjay_support: seeing 5 tickets flagged IMPACT-ACTIVATION-HUB. customers reporting slow search returns. tagging and holding responses until cs copy is ready.

eli_engineering: root cause looks like retry amplification after a partial queue change. working on a retry limiter now. will post when deployed.

maria_cs: draft msg: "We experienced elevated embedding latency for some recent activations during a maintenance window. Engineering has deployed a fix and is reprocessing affected indexes. Expected completion within 4 hours; reply if you need immediate help. We9ll issue a one-time account credit and offer a short onboarding clinic for impacted customers." thoughts?

anne_cs_manager: empathetic + timeline looks good. approve for high-touch wave. copy legal on credit wording.

opsbot: retry limiter v1 deployed at 1769954880. No new errors in last 5m.

eli_engineering: started reprocess job for stuck items (ETA 2-3h). adding synthetic monitor for retry spikes.

maria_cs: splitting outreach: manual to top 20, bulk to the rest. uploading impacted list: https://internal.redwood/drive/activation-impacted-1769954322.csv :eyes:

sanjay_support: canned ticket reply approved. will escalate any still-pending activations after 4h.

maria_cs: thanks team 1f64f will send wave 1 in ~20m and post an internal recap after.
